Subject: Request: DPA amendment & DPIA evidence for upcoming RFP (FedRAMP-adjacent)

Hi Marissa,

Following up from our phone call earlier — Cedar State University is finalizing the vendor shortlist for an upcoming cloud procurement that is FedRAMP-adjacent (state-level education systems). As part of the procurement we require: a DPA amendment that references SCCs where applicable, copies of your latest SOC 2 Type II report, a filled SIG-lite or CAIQ snapshot, and a short DPIA evidence bundle showing data flows and controls for student data (FERPA-adjacent).

Key timeline: the evaluation committee needs the materials by Dec 22 to include you in the final bidder panel. Can you confirm you can provide the DPA amendment (we'll need a redline against our boilerplate), SOC 2 and SIG/CAIQ responses, and a short evidence package (DPIA summary, network diagram, and retention policy)? Also please confirm whether you can accept SCCs or whether you require a DPA with alternative UK/EU clauses.

If feasible, can we get an initial packet and a point-of-contact for legal/security questions? Happy to set a 30-minute call if that helps.

Thanks,
Ellen
Dr. Ellen Park
Director, Procurement & Contracts
Cedar State University
procurement@cedarstate.edu
(555) 555-2104

- Redline DPA amendment (we'll redline against your boilerplate) — Laura (legal) will lead
- SOC 2 Type II (2025) — enclosed (Redwood_Soc2_Type2_2025.pdf)
- SIG-lite / CAIQ snapshot — enclosed (SIG-lite-responses-2026.xlsx)
- DPIA evidence bundle: executive DPIA summary, simplified data flow diagram, retention & deletion policy (we'll provide a short narrative to map to student data categories)

Point people: Laura Bennett (legal) for DPA redlines and contract language; Rishi Malhotra (security/compliance) for SOC 2 and DPIA evidence items.

Can you confirm whether your committee needs explicit SCC language in the DPA text, or if referencing the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (or equivalent UK addendum) with a model clause is acceptable? Some state procurements ask for SCCs even when data residency is US-only.

We'll upload the packet to the shared drive link and send a DocuSign envelope for the DPA redline once we have your requested edits.

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding Ellen's note and our plan. Initial thoughts from Legal:

- We'll prepare a redline DPA that:
  * Keeps SCC reference as an option clause ("In absence of local adequacy, the Parties agree to execute SCCs or equivalent safeguards") to avoid pushing customers into signing foreign-only clauses.
  * Adds a short data-processing schedule enumerating student data categories and processors/subprocessors.
  * Clarifies audit & evidentiary expectations: SOC 2 report + attestations, plus an evidence bundle (DPIA summary, network diagram).

- We should avoid modifying core security obligations that conflict with our SOC 2 scope or cause open-ended audit rights. Where procurement requests unlimited onsite audits, propose a compromise (desktop evidence + scoped onsite with notice).

I'll draft the redline and a short cover note for the procurement committee. Rishi — can you prepare the DPIA extract (1-2 page narrative), a simplified network/dataflow PNG, and confirm whether any student data categories are processed outside US regions? If yes, list regions and subprocessors.

Laura

Laura / Marissa — working on the evidence bundle. Quick status:

- DPIA summary (draft) attached: maps student data categories (enrollment, grades, support notes) to processing flows and retention periods.
- Data flow diagram attached (dpa_dataflow_cedarstate.png) — shows redwood control plane (control metadata only) vs customer data stored in region-specific object stores. Current default region for the account will be us-west-2 unless the customer requests EU region.
- Subprocessors: listed in our published Subprocessor List (we'll include the current PDF). No student-data processing occurs in EU by default; if Cedar requests EU residency, we can discuss contractually-bound region pinning (there is a cost/lead time).
- SOC 2 controls alignment: where the procurement asks for onsite inspections, propose "desktop evidence + scheduled remote interviews" as first-line. We can support limited on-prem or contractually-scoped audits for enterprise procurements only.

I'll finalize the bundle and upload today.

Rishi
